candidate.rationale: Repair archive-slice-bounds mutation: reject an interior surrogate start and move an interior surrogate end backward by one code unit, preserving exports, validation, and return fields.

Repair exact-json-scoring mutation: compare parsed JSON structurally via canonical form that ignores object member order while preserving array order, types, and member presence; keep response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and exact_json_match only for equal parsed values.

Fix controlled retention-tool-pairs mutation: restore uniqueness of call IDs per exchange and positional (index-matched) pairing of tool results to assistant call IDs, preserving exports and masking behavior.

Repair controlled retention-long-window mutation: enforce unique nonempty assistant tool-call IDs within each exchange and exact positional one-to-one tool-result pairing (message.tool_call_id === ids[index]) instead of membership checks, so duplicate IDs and foreign/misordered results are rejected. Masking of old entries and the recent tail are unchanged; export and other behavior preserved.

Fix the empty-history case by allowing a non-negative recentCount up to max(history.length, 1), so an empty history with a positive recentCount returns []. All other behavior (strict positional tool-call/result pairing, call-ID uniqueness, masking of non-recent tail) is preserved, and the replacement is submitted with the required schema version.

Restore retention-tool-pairs validation: require call IDs to be unique per exchange and each tool result to positionally match its assistant call (replacing the too-permissive membership-only check). Resubmission adds the previously missing schema_version field; the source and all protected metadata are preserved exactly as in the rejected proposal.

Compare parsed JSON structurally with isDeepStrictEqual (nested values, order-insensitive object members, order-sensitive arrays), preserving response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and returning exact_json_match only for equal parsed values.

Restore slice-bounds behavior: reject an interior surrogate-pair start and move an interior end backward before a low surrogate, while preserving exports, validation codes, return fields, and the empty-slice-at-EOF case.

Restore surrogate-pair handling: reject an interior start offset and move an interior end backward so no slice begins or ends inside a pair; preserve validation, exports, and return fields. Metadata-only correction: add the required schema_version field; source bytes unchanged from the rejected proposal.

Restore structural JSON equality: compare parsed values with node:util isDeepStrictEqual instead of JSON.stringify string comparison, so object key order is ignored while array order, types, and extra/missing members remain significant. Preserves export, response_not_text and invalid_json reasons, and exact_json_match/answer_mismatch reasons.

Enforce unique call IDs per exchange and positional pairing: each tool result must match the assistant call at the same index, rejecting duplicate IDs, swapped membership-only matches, and foreign call IDs, while preserving recent tail and masking behavior.

Added a tool-call ID uniqueness requirement (new Set(ids).size === ids.length) so duplicate IDs within an assistant message are rejected as retention-tool-pair-invalid. This fixes pair-0 and pair-4, where duplicate IDs made positional matching insufficient. Positional index matching, export, masking window, and hash/stable logic preserved.
